mo_brief.title: MAJOR ORDER
mo_brief.original: Liberate Seasse to protect the Ministry of Science expeditionary teams as they trigger the total collapse of the Void.
mo_brief.translated: 解放西斯以保护科学部远征队，因为他们触发了寂域的全面崩溃。

items.original:
EXOSTORM ADVISORY

A Category 3 Exostorm has been detected on ASPEROTH PRIME, blanketing the planet in violent celestial super-storms.

These unnatural atmospheric anomalies threaten to disrupt our current operations. High Command demands absolute operational resilience in the face of these severe environmental hazards.

Helldivers: defend ASPEROTH PRIME to nullify the Exostorm before it can worsen.

Do not let these celestial tempests halt our advance.
items.translated:
EXOSTORM ADVISORY

在阿斯佩洛斯主星探测到一场3级外风暴，在猛烈的天体超级风暴中覆盖了地球。

这些不自然的大气异常有可能扰乱我们目前的行动。面对这些严重的环境危害，最高指挥部要求绝对的作战弹性。

绝地潜兵：保卫阿斯佩洛斯主星，在外风暴恶化之前使其无效。

不要让这些天风暴阻止我们前进。

items.original:
DSS STATUS UPDATE

The DSS (Democracy Space Station) is undergoing examination after exiting the Void. Reports of rhythmic knocking across the hull have been independently confirmed, and though they have intensified, High Command maintains these vibrations are merely localized thermal contraction. 

The examiners assigned by the Ministry of Truth have volunteered to remain aboard indefinitely to monitor the situation; as a precaution, all outbound shuttle access is suspended.
items.translated:
DSS状态更新

DSS（民主空间站）在离开寂域后正在接受检查。船体上有节奏的敲击声的报道已得到独立证实，尽管它们已经加剧，但最高指挥部坚称这些振动只是局部的热收缩。

真相部指派的审查员自愿无限期留在船上监督情况；作为预防措施，所有出站班车通道暂停。

items.original:
SEASSE SCIENCE EXPEDITION SITREP

The elite 18-person research team has reached the secondary lithospheric layer of Seasse. Sub-surface telemetry remains highly encouraging.

The team has voluntarily deactivated their atmospheric filtration masks to better sample the localized, ecosystem through their own sense of Democracy. Progress remains entirely on schedule.
items.translated:
西斯科学考察团

精英18人研究团队已抵达西斯次级岩石圈层。地下遥测技术仍然非常令人鼓舞。

该团队自愿停用了他们的大气过滤口罩，以便通过他们自己的民主意识更好地对当地的生态系统进行采样。进展完全按计划进行。

items.original:
SEASSE SCIENCE EXPEDITION SITREP

The elite 20-person Ministry of Science team has successfully breached the crust of Seasse. Their objective: to map the subterranean geological geometry and initiate the completely understood dissolution of the Void from its physical core.

High Command reports optimal morale as these brave Patriots begin their descent into the anomaly.
items.translated:
西斯科学考察团

科学部20人的精英团队成功突破西斯地壳。他们的目标：绘制地下地质几何图，并从其物理核心开始完全理解寂域的溶解。

最高指挥部报告称，当这些勇敢的爱国者开始陷入异常状态时，士气最佳。

items.original:
NEW MAJOR ORDER

The Helldivers have reached the heart of the Void: Seasse, and must liberate the planet by any means necessary to stop the spread of this breeding ground for Tyranny.

While forces clear the surface, an elite 20-person Ministry of Science team will descend into its depths to collapse the Void from within. High Command guarantees this process is entirely safe and completely understood.
items.translated:
新重要指令

绝地潜兵已经到达寂域的中心：西斯，必须通过任何必要的手段解放这个星球，以阻止这个暴政滋生地的扩散。

当力量清除表面时，一支20人的科学部精英团队将深入其深处，从内部摧毁寂域。最高指挥部保证这一过程是完全安全和完全理解的。

items.original:
FINAL PREPARATIONS: SEASSE

The Void Warp Relay calibration is complete. Helldivers are advised: T-Minus 1 Hour to Landfall.

The path to to Seasse, the Void source planet, is fully stabilized. All Helldivers are ordered to conclude preparatory operations. Ready for imminent deployment into the heart of the anomaly, and the lawful eradication of the Void.

For Super Earth.
items.translated:
最终准备：西斯

寂域曲速继电器校准完成。建议绝地潜兵：倒计时1小时着陆。

通往寂域源行星西斯的道路已经完全稳定。所有绝地潜兵被命令完成准备行动。准备立即部署到异常的中心，合法铲除寂域。

超级地球。

items.original:
T-MINUS 3 HOURS: SEASSE

Final systems checks are underway across the vanguard fleet. The Void Warp Relay is approaching the terminal energy density required for transit on schedule.

High Command reminds all personnel to report to battle stations and immediately report any unapproved physical mutations. Continue to prepare for imminent, synchronized FTL transit.
items.translated:
倒计时3小时：西斯

先锋舰队正在进行最终系统检查。寂域曲速继电器正在接近按计划运输所需的终端能量密度。

最高指挥部提醒所有人员向作战站报告，并立即报告任何未经批准的物理突变。继续为即将到来的同步FTL运输做准备。
